data.exact_reserve_text: In the calendar year ended 31 December 2017 net claims of GBP 1.1m were able to be released from the 2016 CAT event Hurricane Matthew as claims developed more favourably than anticipated.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Net claims of GBP 1.1m were released as claims developed more favourably than anticipated.

prior_year_events.event_name: External RITC transfer of run-off years (2012-2014)
prior_year_events.impact_description: External RITC of the run-off years transferred assets and liabilities to Syndicate 3330; an external RITC premium attaching to the run-off years contributed to the run-off years' loss.

named_events.loss_description: The net loss impact of the HIM losses booked in the 2017 year of account is GBP 14.6m.
A further GBP 1.5m of net claims arose from the Mexico earthquake in September 2017.
Net losses of GBP 1.8m arising from the Peruvian floods in March 2017.
Net claims of GBP 1.1m were able to be released from the 2016 CAT event Hurricane Matthew as claims developed more favourably than anticipated.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 gross claims outstanding were GBP 62.137m. The report's gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 5.1m (adverse development) across underwriting years up to 2015. Key drivers include adverse reserve developments on older years and the impact of reinsurance-to-close activity on run-off years; there were also mixed individual movements such as a GBP 1.1m net release on Hurricane Matthew. Separately, 2017 saw substantial current-year catastrophe losses (Harvey, Irma and Maria) which impacted the open years.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure was derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross amounts in the technical reserves table). No explicit single-sentence gross prior-year movement was found in the narrative; some narrative amounts are net of reinsurance. The report records external RITC activity for run-off years which can distort development tables; this may affect the triangle-based PYD calculation. Lob-level prior-year movements are not provided in the report, so lob_movements is empty.
